title: Open a file path printed in a pane in the project's nvim
notes: Click a path, or press Alt+O for hint mode (letter labels over every path on screen). Resolve against the pane's live cwd, falling back to the project root. Only existing regular files open. Open with nvim --remote +line in the current window, then switch to nvim mode.

comments.body: Pull request #75: click a path or press Alt+O to open it in the project's nvim at its line. Resolved from the pane's live folder, then its start folder, then the project.
